data.one_liner: Argon2 password hashing for Flutter mobile, desktop, and web apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides Argon2 password hashing and verification functionality using reference C implementations on native platforms and WebAssembly on the web.
use_when: You need secure password hashing using Argon2 in a Flutter application.
You require cross-platform support covering mobile, desktop, and web.
avoid_when: You are using a pure Objective-C iOS setup without Swift/bridging header support and cannot add one.
You need synchronous hashing methods (removed in version 3.0.0).
strengths: Supports a wide range of platforms including mobile, desktop, and web.
Uses reference C implementations and hash-wasm for performance.
weaknesses: Requires extra setup steps for pure Objective-C iOS projects.
Requires explicit initialization calls when used inside isolates or on older Flutter versions.
data.setup_notes: Requires a dummy Swift file with a bridging header for pure Objective-C iOS apps, and build-essential packages on Linux.

alternatives.name: crypto
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need standard Dart cryptographic hashes like SHA or MD5 instead of Argon2.
